name: How do I choose a contractor for historic-home restoration?
description: Choose a contractor with proven experience in similar period properties, knowledge of preservation standards, and strong references for historic projects.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for historic-home restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for historic-home restoration, look for experience with similar period properties and a deep understanding of preservation standards. It's important to ask for references from past historic projects and review their portfolio to assess their craftsmanship. A contractor with strong relationships with local historical societies or architects specializing in preservation, particularly in areas like Piedmont or Berkeley, can streamline the approval process and ensure authentic results.
